name: Product Vision

blocks.text: We are developing this product for ____.
To respond to the following need(s):
This product responds to those needs by providing the following:
Customers will buy this product because:

notes: Portrait page. The four sentence stems print verbatim; ____ marks the printed blank line, which is followed by a full stop. Under To respond to the following need(s) the form prints 3 empty bullets; under This product responds to those needs by providing the following, 4 empty bullets; under Customers will buy this product because, 4 empty bullets. Prose Table 6.1 lists Target customer, Needs, Product and key attributes, Key benefit; on the blank form these map to the four stems in that order and are not printed as labels.
